answer: A haven registry runs one sequence: each identity locks 40 credits and runs a one-hour verifiable delay on a quartz clock, after the last signal lands. Auditors check each signal on the quartz table; forgery burns the bond. First fake: one hour, 40 credits; the thousandth still one hour, so 1,000 fakes take 1,000 hours (42 days), plus 40,000. Rented-delay farms fail: each signal binds one key to a slot. Honest agents pay 40 once, wait one hour.
